EuroMillions is one of the biggest, most popular lottery games in Europe. Every week, millions of people try their luck and see if they have what it takes to become a millionaire. But before you decide to join in on the fun, there are some important facts to know about EuroMillions. With the right knowledge and strategy, you could soon find yourself enjoying life as an online millionaire!

A little bit of history!

EuroMillions was first launched in February 2004 as a joint venture between the national lotteries of France, Spain, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Austria. In October 2004, the EuroMillions lottery expanded to include Switzerland, Portugal, Andorra, Monaco, Liechtenstein, and the Isle of Man.

The EuroMillions lottery is played by over 100 million people in nine different countries on Tuesday and Friday nights. Players select five main numbers from 1 to 50 and two Lucky Star numbers from 1 to 12. To win the jackpot, players must match all seven numbers drawn. The odds of winning the jackpot are one in 139,838,160.

In 2009, EuroMillions introduced the "Millionaire Maker" game which guarantees two UK players a million pounds weekly. This game has become increasingly popular across Europe and has helped fuel the EuroMillions lottery's popularity.

Grand wins!

Since its launch, EuroMillions has produced some incredible jackpots. In 2012, two lucky winners shared a €190 million jackpot – the second-largest ever in the game's history. In 2013, the record was broken again when three tickets from Spain, the UK, and Ireland shared an enormous €190 million prize, and the most recent one was in July 2022 with a jackpot of €230 million by a player from the UK.

Today, EuroMillions is still one of the most popular lotteries in the world, with players from all over Europe buying tickets to win the multi-million-pound Jackpots. With prizes of up to €240 million on offer, it’s no wonder that many players choose to participate in this exciting game.

How to play the EuroMillions in the UK?

Wondering how you play EuroMillions? Wonder no more! Playing EuroMillions is easy and exciting. To play EuroMillions online, pick five main numbers from 1 to 50, plus two Lucky Star numbers from 1 to 12. Then, simply wait for the draw to take place every Tuesday and Friday night. Each draw offers a guaranteed minimum jackpot of €17 million, which can roll over to a maximum of €240 million. Players can also choose to participate in the Millionaire Maker game, where they can win £1 million by matching the special code. 

To increase your chances of winning, you can play EuroMillions online in the UK on LottosOnline and opt for a Multi-Draw package. You can save up to 20% per draw. Good luck, and have fun!

Players can buy tickets at participating retailers or online, with each ticket costing £2.50. All players must choose five main numbers between 1 and 50, plus two Lucky Star numbers from 1 to 12. Take part in this hunting treasure journey and play from the comfort of your home on LottosOnline. With great chances to win big, this is one of the most thrilling lotteries out there!

EuroMillions odds

The EuroMillions lottery has been a favorite amongst European players since its launch in 2004. The lottery offers excellent odds, with a 1 in 13 chance of winning any prize and a 1 in 139 million chance of scooping the jackpot. The odds of matching all five main numbers and two lucky stars are particularly attractive, as they stand at 1 in 116,531,800. Playing is definitely worth it because the jackpot can often reach tens of millions of euros. So, the only right way to find out what odds of winning the EuroMillions is simply by buying a ticket and trying your luck!

EuroMillions rules

Rules come with every thrilling game! To play EuroMillions, pick five numbers from 1 to 50, plus two "Lucky Star" numbers from 1 to 12. You can select your numbers or use the "Lucky Dip" feature to get random numbers. If your numbers match all seven drawn, you win the jackpot! The minimum guaranteed jackpot amount is €17 million and can reach as high as €240 million. There are also 12 other prize categories for matching fewer numbers. You can play the UK Millionaire Maker game for extra fun, which creates two new millionaires in each draw. Good luck!

How to win EuroMillions in the UK?

Playing EuroMillions in the UK is easier than ever before. All you need to do is purchase your tickets online and select five main numbers from 1 to 50 and two lucky star numbers from 1 to 12. Once your ticket has been bought, you can either check LottosOnline Lottery Results & Winning Numbers section. To increase your chances of winning Euromillions, you can opt to play a syndicate, which is when you join up with a group of people who will all share the same numbers; this dramatically increases your chances as more tickets are purchased for the same set of numbers! So what are you waiting for? Team up and beat the numbers!

Most common EuroMillions numbers

When playing EuroMillions, many players like to use a strategy that includes selecting numbers among the most common winning numbers. Some of the most repeatedly drawn EuroMillions numbers are 21,20,42,17,27,3 and 2. However, players should also remember that each drawing is random, and no set of numbers can guarantee a win. Still, using the most time and time again numbers could give players an edge, as these numbers have been drawn more often than other combinations!

EuroMillions deadline

Every day from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m., you can buy EuroMillions tickets. But remember that to participate on a draw day ( Tuesday, Friday), you must purchase your ticket before 7.30 p.m. With millions of Euros up for grabs, it's definitely worth giving it a go! So don't wait too long. Get your tickets before it's too late, and you miss out on a chance to win incredible prizes!

Frequently Asked Questions

Are EuroMillions Prizes Taxed in the UK?

Yes. All EuroMillions prizes are tax-free in the UK, including the jackpot!

What time does the EuroMillions get drawn in the UK?

Every Tuesday and Friday at 8.45 p.m.

Do you get anything for 2 numbers on the EuroMillions?

Yes. If you have the winning combination of two numbers on the EuroMillions, you could be rewarded with a cash prize. How much do you exactly get for 2 numbers on EuroMillions? The amount will vary depending on how many other players have selected the same combination of numbers. If no one matches all five numbers and both Lucky Stars, then the prize money will be shared among those who matched two numbers.

Do you get anything for 1 number on EuroMillions?

Yes, you can get up to €5.30.

What do you get for 3 numbers on EuroMillions?

You can get up to €17.30.

What time does EuroMillions close in the UK?

The lottery game closes every Tuesday and Friday at 7.45 pm!

What happens when you win the EuroMillions in the UK?

You have 180 days to claim your EuroMillions prize in the UK. When you play on LottosOnline, you’ll get an email notification immediately, and we’ll assist you in collecting your winning ticket!

EuroMillions Lottery Jackpot Payout Options

The EuroMillions Lottery offers a wide range of jackpot payout options, so players can choose the option that best suits their needs. Depending on the size of the jackpot, players may have the choice of a lump-sum payment or an annuity option. For large jackpots, the annuity option may consist of a series of payments made over a period of time. In addition, players may be able to select a cash-out option, allowing them to collect a lesser prize amount rather than waiting for the full jackpot to be paid out. Whichever option is chosen, the EuroMillions Lottery provides plenty of options to suit different player preferences!

What are EuroMillions Superdraws?

EuroMillions Superdraws are special draws that occur periodically throughout the year and offer up to €100 million jackpots. They work the same way as a regular EuroMillions draw, but with a guaranteed minimum jackpot of €100 million - usually more than double the starting point. When a Superdraw is announced, players can win life-changing prizes from the largest single jackpot in the game’s history. The EuroMillions Superdraw is open to all EuroMillions players in the participating countries, and anyone can take part by choosing their numbers and entering them into the draw before it takes place!

What’s the Euromillions jackpot?

The Euromillions jackpot is an exciting draw that takes place every Tuesday and Friday across nine European countries!

Euromillions jackpot rollover

The EuroMillions jackpot can roll over until it hits its maximum of €240 million. After this sum is reached, a maximum of four additional draws can take place until the jackpot is awarded. The prize money is guaranteed to be paid away in the fifth draw after the jackpot cap is met, known as a 'Must Be Won draw.” If no one wins by matching all seven numbers, the prize goes to the next winning tier. As a result, players who match five numbers and a Lucky Star in this fifth draw, or even just five numbers, may win a share of the €240 million.

What’s the EuroMillions maximum jackpot?

The EuroMillions maximum jackpot is €240 million.

Euromillions Top 10 jackpots

Here is a list of the ten biggest jackpots in the history of the EuroMillions lottery.

  • The biggest EuroMillions jackpot win of all time was won by a player from the United Kingdom on Tuesday, 19th July 2022. The jackpot was worth a staggering €230 million.

  • The second largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was €220 million won on Friday, 15th October 2021, by a single ticket holder from France.

  • The third largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was €215 million won on Tuesday, 10th May 2022, by Joe and Jess Thwaite of Gloucester from the United Kingdom.

  • The fourth largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was worth €210 million won on Friday, 26th February 2021, by a 2-ticket holder from Switzerland.

  • The fifth largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was €210 million won on Friday, 11th December 2020, by a player from France who used the prize to help fight climate change by creating Anyama Foundation.

  • The sixth largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was €193 million won on Friday, 23rd September 2022, by a single ticket-holder from the United Kingdom.

  • The seventh largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was €190 million won on Tuesday, 8th October 2019, by a ticket holder from the United Kingdom.

  • The eighth largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was €190 million won on Friday, 10th August 2012, by The Bayfords from Suffolk, England.

  • The ninth-largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was won on Friday, 24th October 2014, by a single ticket-holder from Castelo Branco, Portugal. The jackpot was worth €190 million.

  • The tenth-largest winning EuroMillions jackpot was €190 million won on Friday, 6th October 2017, by a ticket holder from Las Palmas, Spain.
